matches.rationale: No finding addresses the specific issue of unrealistically favorable results and lack of variance/confidence intervals in Section 4.2/Figure 9.
No finding targets the inconsistency between the claimed 2× latency reduction and the disclosed prefill overhead; the complexity-analysis finding relates to a different claim.

Finding 5 identifies the asymmetric non-uniform head-budget allocation applied to baselines, which the paper acknowledges yet calls fair, exactly matching the ground truth's concern about biased experimental conditions.
No finding addresses the abstract's exaggerated claims of 'negligible performance loss' and 'significantly outperforms' lacking full substantiation.
No finding mentions the fabricated Corallo et al. reference [14] in Section 5; finding 8 relates to a different false model citation.
No finding discusses the omission of ethical implications or mitigation strategies in the main body for the identified privacy leakage.
No finding points to the conclusion's unqualified, overly positive claims that inflate perceived novelty and impact.
No finding highlights a mismatch between the confident introduction claims of maintaining accuracy at 70% eviction and the varied empirical results.
No finding specifically calls out the unrealistic compute time and peak memory values in Figure 8b given model sizes and context lengths.
No finding addresses the rhetorical manipulation in the introduction (e.g., 'novel,' 'seamlessly integrates') that overhypes the contribution.
No finding identifies the missing IRB, consent, conflict-of-interest, or funding transparency disclosures in the main paper body.

Finding 7 observes that the table shows the same refusal for both full and evicted KV, contradicting the privacy-leak claim; this matches the ground-truth corruption that removes/alters the leak evidence.
Finding 1 details incompatible tensor shapes and inconsistencies in Equation (2) and attention definitions, matching the ground truth's Section 3.2 errors on dimensions and max-operation ranges.

Findings 3 and 4 show impossible full-cache result discrepancies in Figures 22 and 23, directly exemplifying the ground truth's concern about exaggerated relative performance and unrealistic comparative presentation.
No finding reports an omitted or weakened Appendix B discussion of ethical implications, broader impacts, or limitations.
